key_terms.الصُّبْحِ: The dawn, specifically the early morning light
key_terms.تَنَفَّسَ: Breathed, used metaphorically for the spreading of light and life

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the oath of dawn in Surah Al-Mutaffifin?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the personification of dawn 'breathing' (tanaffasa) is often interpreted as the soul of the world receiving divine inspiration or the expansion of light that reveals truth, contrasting with the spiritual darkness of the hypocrites. This oath serves to highlight the precision of divine justice, reminding the reader that just as the dawn's light is undeniable and universal, so too will the deeds of those who cheat in measures be fully exposed on the Day of Judgment.
